notes.title: Launched!
notes.content:
Themes of Dark and Light is now available!

The game features 50 levels as well as 3 challenges where you have to complete a certain number of levels without failing.

Included in the game is a custom level creator that will allow you to create levels, upload them to the Steam Workshop, and share them with your friends.

notes.title: Two weeks until launch!
notes.content:
[h1]Two weeks to go[/h1]

Themes of Dark and Light will be releasing in just two weeks time, on the 15th of September 2021.

The full game will feature 50 levels as well as 3 challenges where you have to complete a certain number of levels without failing.

Included in the full game is a custom level creator that will allow you to create levels, upload them to the Steam Workshop, and share them with your friends.

[h1]Demo[/h1]

Currently available is a free demo where you can try out the first 10 levels before the full game is released.
